scope: Exact gsght.com /imgp impression route, with advisory parameter checks. Click and custom-domain routes remain outside selection.

sources.scope: Custom-domain boundary; no automatic ownership detection

independent_examples: Minimum impression template from network guide.
Published cost and multi-ID examples applied to impression URLs as permitted by the parameter guide.
implemented: Published cost, hash and scope choices.
unconstrained_fields: Hierarchy and reporting strings; arbitrary custom identity types.
Cost amount wire grammar and bounds, currency eligibility, time-window precision/ranges.
Identity formats, hash correctness, per-index dependencies, tracker validity and account state.
source_limits: The parameter page explicitly supports custom company IDs; no closed type enumeration is added.
No HTTP method/header/body table or custom-domain authorization is asserted.
No raw D1 values or identifiers are included.
